jobs_results.title: Project Manager Technology Management (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
Project Manager Technology Management (m/f/d)

REQUISITION ID: 7722

LOCATION: Imarcoain, Navarra, ES, 31119

DEPARTMENT: Service

YOUR TASKS:
• Execution of large technical projects within budget and quality goals
• Securing correct project handling, setting up successful team and leading team members from various departments such as Central engineering, Claim Management, spare parts, production and global Service organization.
• Drive root cause process and define, assess and align dedicated solutions with Nordex internal players as well as external players such as suppliers and customers.
• Ensure technical support to enhance claim toward suppliers.
• Create necessary transparency with regards to an optimization of cost-effectiveness and risk mitigation.
• Work within Nordex processes to manage and report progress on project with a monthly status report.
• Facilitate a smooth handover to colleagues within the Service organization in the different countries
• Representing the Nordex... organization to our clients

YOUR PROFILE:
• Technical background with a Master’s degree in engineering
• Project management experience necessary (preferably in the wind energy sector and in turnkey projects)
• Several years of experience in comparable positions
• Experience with 8D and 6 sigma methods
• Leadership skills and good team forming skills and ability to create a strong, successful and enjoyable team
• Excellent negotiation and communication skills especially with customers or suppliers
• Good MS Office knowledge, SAP experience desirable
• Ability to work in different business cultures
• Willingness to go on business trips from time to time
• Fluent English skills.

Nordex adheres to a policy of equal employment opportunity. All employment decisions are made without regard to religion, age, sex, color, national origin, handicap, or other protected class and in full compliance with all federal and state laws.

ABOUT THE NORDEX GROUP

The manufacture of wind energy plants in the on-shore segment has been our core competence and passion for around 35 years. With more than 46 GW installed capacity worldwide, our turbines supply sustainable energy to more than 80% of the global energy market and we are one of the largest companies in the wind industry. National subsidiaries in more than 30 markets and production facilities in Germany, Spain, Brazil, the USA, Mexico and India offer our more than 9,600 employees the opportunity for international and intercultural cooperation.

We are growing and together driving forward the expansion of alternative energies worldwide - if you wish, from now on with you. Join the #TeamNordex

We look forward to receiving your application! To make it more convenient for you, we are happy to receive your application without a cover letter

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager - Telco Cloud
jobs_results.description:
For over a decade now, OpenNebula Systems has been leading the development of the European open source technology that helps organizations around the world to manage their corporate data centers and build their Enterprise Clouds.

If you want to join an established leader in the cloud infrastructure industry and the global open source community, keep reading, because you can now join a team of exceptionally passionate and talented colleagues whose mission is to help the world's leading enterprises to implement their next-generation edge and cloud strategies. We are hiring!

Since 2019, and thanks to the support from the European Commission, OpenNebula Systems has been leading the edge computing innovation in Europe, investing heavily in research and open source development, and playing a key role in strategic EU initiatives such as the IPCEI-CIS and the “European Alliance for Industrial Data, Edge and Cloud”.

We are currently looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to come and... join us in Europe as part of our new team developing the next generation integrated solution for the Telco Cloud Edge.

Job Description

As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead a growing team responsible for developing OpenNebula’s strategic investment to be the open-source edge infrastructure company for the Telco Cloud, Edge and 5G. OpenNebula's edge cloud infrastructure platform provides retail, automotive, manufacturing, industrial, telco and other edge market segments with a mission-critical environment for deploying virtualization and kubernetes on remote edge devices. The new integrated solution for the Telco Cloud and Edge will be rich enough to host complex applications but flexible enough to scale from hundreds to millions of instances and be deployed across different vertical edge market segments.

The role will be responsible for delivering successful IT projects to design, develop, integrate, deploy, maintain and validate with use cases a new cloud-edge integrated solution for the Telco Edge market. It requires a broad knowledge of the telco industry and related technologies, deep experience with networking and distributed applications, strong background in cloud systems integration, and previous exposure to large-scale software infrastructure architecture, methodologies and tools. He will work closely with users and use cases to understand needs and translate them into scalable and secure cloud architectures. He will also participate in the upstream community, on challenging projects deploying innovative edge/cloud systems. If you are passionate about open source and about driving technological projects to successful completion and thrive in a collaborative, international and innovation-focused environment, we encourage you to apply.

What you will do
• Technical management of international IT projects from initiation to delivery, ensuring adherence to project scope, milestones, KPIs, timelines, and budget
• Analyzing functional and systems requirements and key case studies for solutions to meet the demands of the Telco Edge market
• Defining the design, roadmap and prototype of the cloud-edge architecture for an end-to-end integrated solution for the Telco Edge market
• Designing the APIs, interfaces and data formats of the software components of the integrated cloud system
• Choosing the appropriate cloud services and technologies for the cloud system, and creating the documentation and diagrams of the Telco Edge integrated solution
• Development and technical leadership of the Telco Edge software components, and their integration, deployment and validation using industry use cases
• Utilizing industry-standard project management methodologies to deliver iterative solutions that align with project goals, including the scheduling, managing and coordinating of software releases
• Identifying and evaluating new technologies, innovations, and helps drive partner relationships for alignment with technology roadmap and business value; creates plans for integration and update into architecture
• Working with other companies in the cloud-edge ecosystem within international projects and open-source communities. Availability to occasional travel and participation in international events and meetings
• Writing and maintaining software documentation and project reports
• Creating an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
• Setting clear team goals, delegating tasks and set deadlines for your internal team
• Deploying agile methodology for geographically distributed international team in design, code, and test-plan reviews to help build robust software and promote knowledge sharing
• Working closely with development and engineering teams, and stakeholders to define project objectives, requirements, and deliverables that meet use cases, collaborations and team needs
• Support PMO in reporting on cost/roadmap/resource forecasting
• Contributing to the preparation of new project proposals in the field

What you will bring
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
• 5+ years of hands-on experience delivering large-scale software projects, preferably including telco-industry infrastructure and/or workloads
• Hands-on experience in managing or contributing to open source projects
• Strong leadership skills, including the ability to set goals and provide constructive feedback respectfully to build positive relationships and improve business results
• Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization and to interact with external stakeholders
• Multi-tasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in a timely manner
• Hands-on experience in Network Functions Virtualization (NFV) and Software-Defined networking (SDN) applied to wireline and wireless networks
• Knowledgeable in 4G and 5G Radio network architecture and ecosystem, and 3GPP specifications
• Knowledgeable in Telco Edge operation, management and orchestration (e.g., MANO), MEX specifications, Network Management, OSS/BSS, and TM Forum standards
• Strong technical knowledge of open-source and/or disaggregated Telco solutions
• Broad experience with Linux operating system development, automation and performance tuning
• History of innovation with examples of developing new technologies, software architecture and designs
• Experience writing Terraform modules and managing deployments of virtualized infrastructures with Terraform
• Experience using public Clouds (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, etc…), understand the limitations and peculiarities of the networking and storage model of each provider
• Experience deploying and using monitoring and alerting tools like Prometheus. Design monitoring metrics and associated data structure. Elaborate and analyze usage reports obtained from the monitor data
• Experience with Cloud Management platforms and their associated technologies. Understand the implication of managing virtualized infrastructures and the orchestration of the underlying subsystems.

What's in it for me?

Some of our benefits and perks vary depending on location and employment type, but we are proud to provide employees with the following:
• Competitive compensation package and flexible remuneration: Meals, Transport, Nursery/Childcare
• Customized workstation (macOS, Windows, Linux)
• Private health insurance
• Paid time off: Holidays, Personal Time, Sick Time, Parental leave
• Afternoon-off every friday and during summer
• Remote company with bright HQ centrally located in Madrid; offices in Boston (USA), Brussels (Belgium) and Brno (Czech Republic); and access to office space near your location when needed. During the first year, for onboarding purposes, and for participation on certain projects, employees should be able to attend events and face-to-face meetings in our Madrid offices and be available to travel to Brussels and maybe other European cities. All employees are also required to attend our company-wide face-to-face all-hands meetings twice a year
• Healthy work-life balance: We encourage the right for Digital Disconnecting and promote harmony between employees personal and professional lives
• Flexible hiring options: Full Time/Part Time, Employee (Spain/USA) / Contractor (other locations)
• We are building an awesome, Engineering First Culture and your opinion matters: Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued
• Be exposed to a broad technology ecosystem. We encourage learning and researching new technologies and methods as part of your everyday duties

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth story while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Global Records and Information Management Organization:

GRO provides... solutions for customers in various industries to transform their business, driving revenue and growth.

Job summary

The Project Manager will be working closely with the Sales Team and Operations Team to gather projects requirements ( activities, He is also responsible for ensuring all internal and external projects are tracked, managed and implemented in an effective manner, to the required specification and within budget. Formal project management methodologies are to be utilized as per the IME standards and project matrix.

Your role in our mission:
• Working closely with the sales team on proposals and pitches for business.
• Attending meetings with Business Developers, putting together business cases for the Sales Teams to support their proposals.
• Working closely and collaboratively with customers to devise effective solutions.elopement Managers/Executives and acting as a technical expert.
• Working closely with customers to understand and capture requirements.
• Presenting proposals to customers alongside members of the sales team.
• Producing detailed costings for customers and ensuring the contract is profitable.
• Project Planning – All documentation as required for the project scale to be created, revised and communicated throughout theteam
• Produce all required Project Management documentation

Valued skills and experience:
• Graduate calibre
• At least 3 years Project Management experience in a complex, multi-project environment
• Experience of working within different levels within an organisation from Operative to Senior Executive
• Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high pressure environment
• Ability to drive the implementation of multiple projects to agreed standards, and implement transition support appropriate IME teams
• Excellent Project Management skills including Microsoft Project

Discover what awaits you
• Discover Limitless Possibilities: Embark on an exciting journey with Iron Mountain, a global organization that embraces transformation and innovation.
• Empowering Inclusion: Join a supportive environment where everyone's voice is heard, opinions are valued, and feedback is encouraged, fostering an atmosphere of inclusion and belonging.
• Global Connectivity: Connect with 26,000+ talented individuals from 59 countries, opening doors to diverse cultures and fostering global learning opportunities.
• Championing Individuality: Be part of a winning team that celebrates diversity and encourages individual differences to drive greatness.
• Competitive Total Rewards: supporting your career at Iron Mountain, family, personal wellness, and wellbeing. (Local benefits may vary based on country-specific policies.)
• Unleash Your Potential: Access abundant opportunities for personal and professional growth, preparing you for a digitalized future.
• Valuing Every Contribution: Join a workplace that actively encourages and supports all talents, recognizing the unique impact of each individual.
• Pioneering Sustainability: Contribute to our vision of fostering a sustainable and thriving workforce, leaving an enduring legacy for generations to come.

Category: Project/Program Management Group

Iron Mountain is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. We recruit and hire applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law.

To view the Equal Employment Opportunity is the Law posters and the supplement, as well as the Pay Transparency Policy Statement, CLICK HERE

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Madrid
jobs_results.description:
Key Role Profile:

As a Project Manager you will lead on a number of commercial projects representing Unispace in a professional manor while gaining the confidence and trust of the client during the full project lifecycle.

In this role you will be site based carrying out full project management. You will be the main point of contact for clients, contractors and senior management. You will create a programme for each project to make sure everything runs on time and within budget.

Key Responsibilities:

Your primary responsibilities will include the full Project Management of projects to help deliver the regions plan. The Delivery team at Unispace are self-motivated, driven and focused on delivering construction excellence, exceptional standards around health & Safety, true attention to detail and constant positive work ethic.

The main elements of the role involve the following:
• Ensuring projects meet financial targets
• Ensuring thorough understanding of project terms (contract... and Unispace 80/20 methodology
• Executing project delivery strategy
• Ensuring all monthly financial project reports are reviewed for accuracy and profitability
• Managing client and supply chain vendors (project specific stakeholders)
• Controlling documentation quality
• Adhering to health and safety
• Managing programs/ schedules
• Effective client communication throughout the delivery phase
• Leading the integration of disciplines (strategy, client relations, business development, marketing & communications, design, project management) to enable the effective delivery of our Unispace 80/20 methodology within projects
• Leading and developing a high performing local project delivery team
• Collaborating across disciplines, regions, studios
• Managing the performance of consultants
• Contributing to the creation of a high performing, innovative team environment
• Effective internal communication throughout all phases of the project
• Implementing Delivery best practices/standards, processes and technology solutions within the studio to enhance the capability and effectiveness of the organisation/team
• Identifying and reporting risk to Principal, Delivery and Regional Managing Director, where relevant, whilst operating in compliance with ethical practices
• Project close out

Key Measures:
• Budget and net profit targets met
• Effective cash flow management
• Accurate and timely reporting of project performance
• Effective sub-contractor negotiation
• Secures repeat client business
• Client satisfaction in line with organisational goals
• High % of project milestones delivered on time
• Colleague cooperation and engagement towards achieving project outcomes.
• Delivers project reports (schedule, accoutrement, financials)
• O&M manual, as built financial close out in timely manner
• Achieve quality assurance and quality control
• Actions taken to identify and resolve risks and issues
• Consistency of standards, technology solutions and process across local studio to achieve global brand capability, drive best practices, and achieve efficiencies

Key Qualifications, experience & skills:
• You must be graduate caliber and have a Construction and/or related Project management qualification (desired but not essential)
• Managed multiple successful projects varying in size, value and complexity
• Led a project team
• Help with project pitches
• Project procurement
• Sub contractor selection
• Experience with project management software tools and Microsoft office suite
• Commercial interior office fit-outs
• Design & Build experience
• Team development
• Influencing others
• Building relationships
• Communicating with impact
• Driving for results
• Time management
• Problem solving
• Initiative
• Building code
• Healthy and safety standards
• Construction planning, estimating, budgeting and forecasting
• Commercial awareness

jobs_results.title: Delivery Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
As a Delivery project Manager you will be responsible for planning, organizing, and directing the completion of specific projects for an organization while ensuring these projects are on time, on budget, and within scope. The Project Manager works alongside Technical Integration Managers and Account Managers.

As a project manager you will proactively lead stakeholders from across the group, locally and remotely.

Key Responsibilities
• Determine and define project scopes and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.
• Develop and manage a detailed project plan and schedules
• Develop comprehensive project plans to be shared with the partner and project team
• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
• Prepare budget based on scope of work and resource requirements
• Coordinate internal resources and external for the flawless execution of projects
• Provide project updates on a consistent basis to various stakeholders about... adjustments and progress.
• Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope and budget.
• Utilize industry best practices, techniques, and standards throughout entire project execution
• Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools and techniques
• Perform risk management to minimize project risks
• Establish and maintain relationships with internal departments as well as external partners.
• Direct point of contact with GIG partners and being the bridge between all GIG verticals.
• Support in the development of the PMO department with improving running processes and documentations as well as educating the wider group.
• Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule, and project costs using appropriate verification techniques
• Report and escalate to management as needed
• Ensure resource availability and allocation
• Meet with clients to take detailed ordering briefs and clarify specific requirements of each project
• Track project performance, specifically to analyze the successful completion of short and long-term goals
• Meet budgetary objectives and make adjustments to project constraints based on financial analysis

Requirements

You are structured and able to have several tasks in motion at the same time and experience of working with B2B partners and manage expectations.
• Drive - You are a person that makes a strong, positive impression and maintains high levels of activity and produces great results through people. As such, passion for the industry and a sense of urgency is highly desirable.
• Teamwork - You understand the requirements for good-to-great collaboration and aim to achieve common goals. It is important that you build sound relationships based on mutual trust and openness.
• Leadership - Consideration, respect and trust. People generally respond according to the way they are treated. If you give a little, you will invariably get a lot back.
• Time Management - You will be working with internal teams, customers and management, often spinning multiple plates at once.
• Budgeting - Keep and maintain a budget. You will need to be confident in using math skills to make sure you know where your company’s money is going.
• Analytical Skills - You have analytical skills to be able to solve problems that may come up during a typical work day. You will be analyzing data and making decisions that affect the project on a regular basis.
• Industry experience - previous experience working within the iGaming industry, preferably for a B2B Casino/Sportsbook provider is highly appreciated.

Benefits
• Great career development opportunities
• Hybrid working model
• International Health Insurance
• Health and Wellbeing Package (350 EUR per year)
• Birthday Day Off
• Me Time - 1 day off per year

jobs_results.title: Project Management Office / PMO Manager
jobs_results.company_name: Radisson Hotel Group, Madrid Office-Information Technology
jobs_results.description:
Mission:
The Project Management Office (PMO) manager mission is to introduce, maintain & measure a consistent approach to managing projects. It oversees the administration of projects to ensure support of the standards, methodology and technology defined by the IT organization.

Role purpose:
Primary role of the PMO manager is to apply a set of supporting activities for the consumption of both the Project Management teams as well as governance & reporting for Radisson’s IT senior management, in line with the goals set by the Transformation Office Lead. This will include application of practical management controls that support improved project/organizational performance.

Responsibilities:
Play a key role in implementing the company’s project management governance and methodologies for the project
• Drive adoption of best practices among project management community
• Own documentation strategy
• Provide key project analysis to key stakeholders
• Maintain and update project management... controlling & reporting tools; deliver senior-level status reports to the steering committees
• Maintain documentation for projects including tracking of risks, action logs and project deliverables (as needed)
• Assure initial quality on received data inputs based on given guidelines
• Report on project performance and KPIs
• Provide other PMO support to project managers such as vendor & contract management, cost management, resource management.
• Strategy: Define and drive the IT project management best practices within the Corporate domains with the Transformation Office Lead to support the 5 Year Plan initiative and EMMA – RHG’s Corporate Global Platform.
• Solution Design: Ensure that the internal and external Business Relationship Managers and Project managers adopt to the solution design processes and templates defined by the Transformation/Project Management Office.

RHG’s Corporate ideal PMO shows:
• Ability to connect the dots through a Stakeholder’s eyes with a keen ability to sift through the clutter of data to articulate the business strategy and the alignment of prioritized IT initiatives to achieve it faster, more efficiently and with a measurable outcome.
• Strong consulting, facilitation and negotiation experience, preferably with external customers.
• Succinct executive level verbal and written business communication in non-IT lingo.
• Analytical skills to measure and drive key business decisions on process & systems to enable the overall company success.
• Corporate Industry knowledge or similar one
• Sound knowledge of Project Management methodology and function
• Ability to drive multiple program stream status updates, action and RAID logs
• Excellent attention to details, accuracy and analytical mindset
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills
• Strong program/project management skills

Requirements:
Preferred but not required bachelor's degree in computer science or information systems
Minimum experience: +5 years in Global / Area / Regional IT Management role, +5 years relevant experience working in capacity of a PMO / Project Manager, +2 years experience on IT vendor management
At least 10 years of multi-disciplined IT experience including:
• Proven experience in a PMO role
• Experience implementing new project management practices or reviewing / improving existing processes and templates
• Experience in software development or implementation project life cycle
• Experience in large sophisticated IT organizations with high volume/high transaction environment.
• Regional/Global management experience and teaming experience including line management.
• Experience working in a fast-past environment with a strong ability to show initiative
• Experience in writing documents, preparing process workflows, doing professional ppt decks/papers/minutes to a high standard
• Advanced user level experience with MS Office (Excel, Access, PowerPoint)
• Exposure to both change management and business analysis
• Strong in processing complex tasks quickly working with Agile methodologies
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills.
• Strong program/project management skills
Soft skills:
• Making customers more successful: Customer-oriented mind-set, capable of maintaining relationships & build trust at director level & above across multiple stakeholders, goal-oriented individual.
• Shaping direction: strategic oriented individual, capable of envisioning, developing, aligning and communicating the processes and tools to execute successful projects and initiatives
• Performance: High performance individual, who takes responsibilities & deliver towards them, by coordinating effort and aligning resources to achieve objectives.
• Communication: Clear communication view, able to adapt it to the audience (technical, manager, executive), internal or external), in a variety of format presentation settings: one to one, small and large groups, with peers etc.
• Change management: Able to act as a change agent, initiating, sponsoring, enabling and driving transformative changes of strategic significance. Help drive the deployment and adoption of the industry best practices across the organization.
English at negotiation level as a minimum.

#LI-DM1

Compensation: To be discussed

jobs_results.description:
We are selecting a Project Manager for Cummins Spain, San Fernando de Henares. Hybrid work model, travelling 60%, relocation is not eligible. English high level (C1 Cambridge equivalent) is a MUST. In this role, you will make an impact in some of the following ways: - Identifying project stakeholders, risks, work scope, budget and schedule expectations - Developing Project Plans - Reporting to both internal and external stakeholders, including Company Leaders, the status of his/her projects: time schedule, costs vs. Budget, risks, technical issues, etc - Coordinating with subject matter experts to ensure that the project execution plan has correctly identified the required resources, tools, and methodology. - Understanding project activities and interdependencies in order to support the development of an accurate budget and schedule, then managing project execution accordingly. - Understanding contractual terms and conditions - Serving as the primary client interface - Supporting the... establishment of effective working relationships, both within the project team and between the project team and external stakeholders. Measuring project performance, forecasting outcomes and, when necessary, developing proactive course corrections - Ensuring that the project team is adhering to applicable Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) and Quality Management, and Projects Systems - From the sales process, identifying and register the Projects’ risks, monitoring these risks while using creativity and out-of-the-box thinking to propose mitigation
To be successful in this role you will need the following: - Engineering College, University, or equivalent degree required - Electrical or Mechanical background preferably - Relevant work experience in Engineering Project Management (2 to 4 years minimum) - Very high level of Spanish & English language: written and oral communications (minimum level C1 equivalent) - Main skills/competences: Excellent Communication skills, Team oriented, Solution driven. - Availability to travel (60%)
Compensation Class

jobs_results.title: Promotions Project Manager Intern
jobs_results.description:
Hi, we’re Fever
We’re excited you are checking out this job offer.

We are the leading global live-entertainment discovery tech platform with a clear mission: to democratize access to culture and entertainment.

How do we achieve our mission? Fever has developed a proprietary technology that inspires a global community of over 125M people through personalized and curated experiences in their local city whilst empowering entertainment and event creators to reach new audiences and enhance their experience.

Sounds amazing, right?

About the Role

The Secret Media Network (which publishes Madrid Secreto, Secret NYC, Secret Chicago, Secret London, etc.) is looking for an ambitious, creative and talented project manager intern. We're on the lookout for an enthusiastic individual to take the helm in managing our global giveaway project. This internship provides an excellent opportunity for you to contribute your innovative ideas and skills to enhance and oversee our giveaway... initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and implement creative strategies to elevate and streamline our giveaway projects.
• Adhere to established communication procedures, guidelines, and policies.
• Provide vital support to senior managers in achieving project objectives.
• Oversee and manage the terms and conditions established by the legal department.
• Maintain close collaboration with editorial teams worldwide to coordinate giveaway publications.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to efficiently manage codes and prizes for all giveaways.

About You:
• Currently enrolled in Communication Studies, Advertising, or Marketing (must be able to sign a University Agreement with your school).
• Previous experience in community management is highly valued.
• Proficient in both written and spoken English.
• Exceptional management skills with strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication, as well as presentation abilities.
• A keen interest in staying updated with digital technology trends and a strong understanding of digital media trends, including the ability to identify content that resonates with online audiences.
• Proven ability to adapt to the dynamic and fast-paced environment of a digital startup.
• Enthusiasm for working collaboratively in a growing company as an integral part of a dynamic team.
• Must be based in Madrid, Spain, or willing to relocate.

Benefits & Perks
• Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences!
• Work in a location in the heart of Madrid
• Home office friendly
• Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
• Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
• We have free food, drinks and fruit at the office!

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: Civil Design & Works Package Leader (F/M)
jobs_results.description:
Job Description Summary
Gris System Integration (GSI) is in charge of delivering turnkey high voltage substation project involving all technologies. These integrated solutions enable large scale electrification and integration of green, sustainable renewable energy with a great sense of purpose

Job Description

Within GSI South Europe, the Civil Work Leader is responsible for the valuation of Civil Engineering & Civil works activities during the tender phase (ITO), . Acting under the direction of the tender leader, he covers all fields of Civil Engineering: earthworks, drainage, foundation, building, building services, …

During project execution (OTR) he/she is in charge of delivering the civil works scope of projects reporting to the project director and in coordination with all other project functions..

He ensures that Safety, Quality, Costs and Schedule comply with contractual obligations, company policy and local regulation.

In link with Sourcing & Procurement, he has major... contributions to the management of the portfolio of suppliers & sub-contractor in his field.

He reports to the GSI Construction Regional lead and participate to the function’s objective definitions and their follow up.

Network & Links:
• Internal: Project Director, Project Managers, Project engineering director, Plant engineering, Internal Project Design entities, Project Controller, Site Manager, Commissioning Manager, Site Eng/Supervisors.
• External: Customer, Subcontractors/partners, staffing agencies.

Major Responsibilities:

Health and Safety
• Demonstrate EHS leadership and ensure Safety by Design & STOP WORK policies are implemented.
• Ensures application of GE GRID EHS Policy and procedures in all activities.

Quality
• Maintain/update tools, templates, design books to be used in civil design/works activities within projects.
• Participate to continuous improvement actions of Design & Construction phases .
• Treatment of Non Conformities and Lessons Learned

Skills / Qualifications:
• Appropriate qualification in Civil Engineering, degree level with around 10 years of work experience.
• Appropriate health and safety experience, training and qualifications in line with international standards for roles of this nature.
• Great interpersonal skills & ability to lead working teams in complex organizations across countries.
• Ability to communicate effectively, and to accurately and concisely report both verbally and in writing.
• Proficiency in ENGLISH mandatory / Additional European language a plus
• Good level in CAD tools (Autocad, Revit & BIM platforms)
• Good IT proficiency including collaborative platforms & tools.

Experience:
• Direct experience in designing and/or delivering civil works for HV substations or similar industrial projects, preferably in European countries.

Knowledge:
• Valuation methodology of civil design/works.
• Key applicable standards and specifications associated with the civil works applicable for countries in the region.
• Environmental legislation and good industry practice in relation to construction works.
• Civil Design Outsourcing
• Design-Build contracting strategies.

Other:
• Office-based position - will require frequent travelling to suppliers & project sites across the region.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No
